# the pair scan: 325 letter pairs, blocks, prefix sums
#
# Regenerate with:  python -m tools.make_traces
# Do not edit by hand: tests/test_docs_traces.py compares this file with a
# fresh run of the code it shows.

## pair_scan('aabbc') -- one row per letter pair

'blocks' counts the maximal runs of consecutive positions occupied by the
two letters; 'block sizes' shows how long those runs are.  A balanced
substring can only live inside a block, which is why the pair (a, c) -- with
blocks 'aa' and 'c' -- contributes nothing.

+------+--------+-------------+------+------------------+
| pair | blocks | block sizes | best | substrings found |
+------+--------+-------------+------+------------------+
| ab   |      1 | 4           |    4 | aabb             |
| ac   |      2 | 2 1         |    0 | -                |
| bc   |      1 | 3           |    2 | bc               |
+------+--------+-------------+------+------------------+
best over all pairs: 4

## pair_scan('abcabc')

+------+--------+-------------+------+------------------+
| pair | blocks | block sizes | best | substrings found |
+------+--------+-------------+------+------------------+
| ab   |      2 | 2 2         |    2 | ab               |
| ac   |      3 | 1 2 1       |    2 | ca               |
| bc   |      2 | 2 2         |    2 | bc               |
+------+--------+-------------+------+------------------+
best over all pairs: 2
